_comment: Development overlay for the generic Web application tab, the first embedded slot.
This file no longer carries the shipped defaults. Whether the tab appears, and with what
address and name, are fields on WebAppSlot::generic() in src/slic3r/GUI/WebAppPanel.cpp --
this file is excluded from the installer, so a customer machine has nothing to read. That
tab ships switched off with no address: it hosts whatever a developer points it at, which is
not a feature of the product. Set ORCA_WEB_APP_URL to bring it up on a development machine;
the override wins over everything here and is never written back.
The tab will host any web application that speaks the bridge documented in
WEB_APP_BRIDGE.md, with a worked example in resources/web/webapp-example.
_extra_origins_comment: Additional https origins the tab may NAVIGATE to, so a vendor page can be browsed in place
instead of bouncing the user out to their desktop browser. Navigable is NOT trusted: the
bridge session token is injected only on the slot's own address, so a page reached this way
cannot call slicer.* at all. A bar appears across the top of the tab whenever the user is on
one of these, naming the site and offering a way back and a way out to a real browser.
